name: sagar-plugins
description: Sagar's personal Factory plugins marketplace — multi-model droid toolkit split into focused plugins.

plugins.name: investigation
plugins.description: Investigation droids: fast triage (quick-analysis), thorough repo investigation (deep-understanding), external web research (deep-research), and root-cause debugging (debugger).

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Pre-merge review droids (strict diff reviewer, security reviewer, and the pinned review-worker deep-tier subagent) plus the review-fix skill (/review-fix): review a change read-only (light single-pass or deep exhaustive multi-pass, auto-escalated for risky diffs), triage existing PR threads, apply the fixes, verify, and commit locally before push.

plugins.name: synthesis
plugins.description: Synthesis droids: PR description writer (pr-describer) and Conventional Commits message writer (commit-message-writer).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Meta droids and skills for working on agentic configs themselves: prompt audit (prompt-optimizer), apply (doc-generator), and the audit-and-apply-loop methodology skill.

plugins.name: practices
plugins.description: Planning and engineering-discipline skills plus the planner droid (claude-fable-5 evidence-anchored planning engine that spec delegates heavy planning to): spec, tech-spec, architecture-scan, grilling, grill-me, discovering-unknowns, TDD workflow, coding standards, verification loop, and agentic-engineering operating principles. The spec skill registers /spec as its direct entry point.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Hands-on tools that change and land code: implementer (applies approved review findings, spec units, or fix lists), test-engineer (finds the riskiest untested behavior and writes the missing tests), the fix-pr skill (/fix-pr: fetch, reason about, fix, reply, resolve, wait for CI, and approve PRs end-to-end), the implement skill (/implement: route to implementer or tdd-workflow with the Deviations contract), and the ship skill (/ship: commit, push, template-conformant PR body, CI watch, resolve threads, merge-ready report).
